title: DHCPv6: Change tests due to optlen being unsigned
description:
Comparisons of the form (optlen - temp_optlen) > 0 don't work well
when optlen and temp_optlen are unsigned. To extra guard against
overflow, use tvb_reported_length_remaining since we have a tvb
of the appropriate reported length already.

Fix #21254

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
